verses.text: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

verses.text: Should not the multitude of words be answered? And should a man full of talk be justified?

verses.text: Should thy boastings make men hold their peace? And when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?

verses.text: For thou sayest, My doctrine is pure, And I am clean in thine eyes.

verses.text: But oh that God would speak, And open his lips against thee,

verses.text: And that he would show thee the secrets of wisdom! For he is manifold in understanding. Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.

verses.text: Canst thou by searching find out God? Canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?

verses.text: It is high as heaven; what canst thou do? Deeper than Sheol; what canst thou know?

verses.text: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, And broader than the sea.

verses.text: If he pass through, and shut up, And call unto judgment, then who can hinder him?

verses.text: For he knoweth false men: He seeth iniquity also, even though he consider it not.
